topstep.name: Topstep
topstep.summary: Monthly-priced evaluation (the Trading Combine) with an end-of-day trailing loss limit, a 55% best-day rule and a 90/10 payout split.

plans.price: $49 a month + $149 activation, or $95 a month with no activation fee
plans.dd_type: End-of-day trailing, locks at the starting balance
plans.consistency: Best day at most 55% of profit
plans.label: 50K

plans.price: $99 a month + $149 activation, or $149 a month with no activation fee
plans.dd_type: End-of-day trailing, locks at the starting balance
plans.consistency: Best day at most 55% of profit
plans.label: 100K

plans.price: $199 a month + $149 activation, or $229 a month with no activation fee
plans.dd_type: End-of-day trailing, locks at the starting balance
plans.consistency: Best day at most 55% of profit
plans.label: 150K

rules: Best-day rule in the Combine: your best single day has to stay at or under 55% of your profit. Going over it doesn't fail you, but it raises the profit you need before you pass. Losing days don't shrink your best day.
The maximum loss limit trails your end-of-day balance and stops moving once it reaches your starting balance.
The daily loss limit is optional and chosen at checkout. Hitting it stops trading until 5 PM CT; it isn't a rule break.
A reset costs one month's price.
payout: In the Express Funded Account the balance starts at $0 and the loss limit trails up and locks at $0. After your first payout it's set to $0.
You pick one payout path when the funded account is activated, and it can't be changed.
Standard path: 5 winning days of at least $150 each. Cap per request $2,000, $3,000 or $5,000 for 50K, 100K and 150K.
Consistency path: 3 trading days, with your best day at most 40% of profit since your last payout. Cap per request $3,000, $4,000 or $6,000.
Every request: at least $125, at most 50% of the balance, split 90% to you and 10% to Topstep. ACH or wire costs $30 per payout.
sources: What is the maximum loss limit
unverified: Topstep's help pages show only relative update dates, so we record the date we read them.
A promotion that doubles payout caps when you add a daily loss limit has no published end date, so it isn't used here.
The funded account's scaling plan (contracts allowed at each balance) isn't published as text.

payout: Topstep 50K funded, Standard path
Topstep 50K funded, Consistency path
Topstep 150K funded, Standard path

consistency_page.lede: In Topstep's Trading Combine your best day can't be more than 55% of your profit. In a funded account on the Consistency payout path, the limit is 40% of profit since your last payout.
points: Combine: best single day at or under 55% of total profit. Topstep suggests keeping your best day under $1,650, $3,300 or $4,950 for 50K, 100K and 150K.
Going over 55% doesn't fail the Combine. It raises the profit you need: best day divided by 0.55.
Losing days don't make your best day smaller, but they do lower your total, which raises your best day's share.
Funded, Consistency path: best day at most 40% of profit since your last payout, over at least 3 trading days. The count starts again after each payout.
Funded, Standard path: no consistency rule, but you need 5 winning days of $150 or more.

compare.price: $49 a month + $149 activation, or $95 a month
compare.payout_consistency: 40% on the Consistency path, none on Standard
compare.payout_cap: $2,000 Standard or $3,000 Consistency, and at most 50% of the balance

tradeify.name: Tradeify
tradeify.summary: One-time evaluations with no activation fee, end-of-day trailing drawdown and a 90% split, in Growth, Select and Lightning (instant funding) plans.

plans.label: Growth 50K
plans.dd_type: End-of-day trailing; never locks in the evaluation
plans.consistency: None in the evaluation, 35% for payouts

plans.label: Select 50K
plans.dd_type: End-of-day trailing; never locks in the evaluation

rules: Tradeify checks consistency as your biggest end-of-day profit day divided by the limit: that's the total profit you need. Landing exactly on the limit passes.
Every plan is a one-time purchase with no activation fee.
Drawdown trails your end-of-day balance. In an evaluation it never locks. In a funded 50K account it locks at $50,100 once your end-of-day balance reaches $52,100.
The daily loss limit is soft: hitting it ends your day, not the account. The Select evaluation has none.
Select comes with a 40% consistency rule as standard; 30% and 50% versions are sold too.
payout: Every plan splits payouts 90% to you.

Growth funded (50K): 5 winning days of $150 or more, best day at most 35% of profit, at least $500 a request, caps of $1,500, $2,000, $2,500, then $3,000 from the fourth payout. The balance has to be at least $53,000 to ask.
Select Flex (50K): every 5 winning days of $150 or more, at least $250, up to $2,500 a request for accounts bought from September 1, 2026.
Select Daily (50K): payouts any day once a $2,100 buffer is reached; the buffer can't be withdrawn. At least $250, up to $1,250 a request.
Lightning (50K): reach a $3,000 profit goal for the first payout and $2,000 after that, with best day at most 20%, 25%, then 30%. At least $1,000, up to $2,000 for payouts 1 to 3 and $2,500 after.
sources: Select Flex and Select Daily payout policies
unverified: Accounts bought before September 12, 2025 or September 1, 2026 keep older caps and minimum balances, which aren't shown here.
Lightning 100K changed on November 23, 2026, and its new lock level wasn't published when we checked.
How Select Flex's 'up to 50% of total profit' wording combines with the per-request cap isn't clear on Tradeify's page.

consistency_page.lede: Tradeify's consistency rule depends on the plan: 40% in a Select evaluation, 35% for Growth funded payouts, and 20%, 25%, then 30% for Lightning payouts.
points: The check: biggest end-of-day profit day divided by the limit is the total profit you need. A $900 best day at 40% means $2,250.
Select evaluation: 40% as standard, with 30% and 50% versions on sale. There's no consistency rule in a Growth evaluation.
Growth funded: 35% for each payout. Lightning funded: 20% for the first payout, 25% for the second and 30% after that.
Exactly at the limit counts as a pass.

payout: Tradeify Select Daily 50K

mffu.name: MyFundedFutures
mffu.summary: One-time evaluations with no activation fee in Builder, Rapid, Rapid EOD and Pro plans. Core is an older plan that's no longer sold.

plans.label: Builder 50K
plans.consistency: None in the evaluation, 50% for payouts

plans.label: Rapid 50K
plans.dd_type: End-of-day in the evaluation, intraday trailing when funded, locks at $50,100
plans.consistency: Best day at most 50% in the evaluation

plans.label: Rapid EOD 50K
plans.dd_type: End-of-day trailing, locks at $50,100 when funded
plans.contracts: 3 minis or 30 micros (one page says 4 or 40)
plans.consistency: Best day at most 30% in the evaluation

plans.label: Pro 50K
plans.dd_type: End-of-day trailing until your first payout, then fixed at $50,100
plans.contracts: 3 minis or 30 micros in the evaluation
plans.consistency: Best day at most 50% in the evaluation

rules: Every plan is a one-time purchase with no activation fee. Prices on the site are often promotional, so check the current price at checkout.
Rapid has two drawdown types: end-of-day trailing in the evaluation, but intraday trailing once funded, so open trades move the level.
Builder's daily loss limit pauses you for the day; it doesn't fail the account. Rapid, Rapid EOD and Pro have none.
Rapid's 50% and Rapid EOD's 30% consistency rules apply only in the evaluation.
payout: Funded accounts must first build a $2,100 buffer above the starting balance before any payout.

Builder (50K): first payout needs $500 of profit above the buffer, best day at most 50% of the cycle's profit, at least $500, up to $2,000, split 80/20. After 5 sim payouts you move to a live account.
Rapid (50K): payouts every day once the buffer is reached, at least $500, split 90/10.
Rapid EOD (50K): payouts every day; $2,100 buffer before the first, then $500 profit since the last. At least $500, split 90/10.
Pro (50K): eligible 14 days after your first trade once the buffer is reached, at least $1,000, split 80/20. Since November 23, 2026, one funded Pro account per size.
unverified: Most per-size prices and all reset fees, because the site shows promotional 'starting at' prices.
Rapid's maximum payout per request isn't stated.
MFFU's own pages disagree on some contract limits and on Builder 150K's payout cap.

consistency_page.lede: MyFundedFutures uses a consistency rule in different places by plan: 50% for Builder payouts, and 50% (Rapid) or 30% (Rapid EOD) in the evaluation.
points: Builder: no consistency rule in the evaluation. For each payout, your largest single day must be at most 50% of that cycle's profit. It resets after each approved payout.
Rapid: best day at most 50% of profit in the evaluation, with at least 2 trading days. No consistency rule once funded.
Rapid EOD: best day at most 30% in the evaluation, with at least 4 trading days.
Pro: 50% in the evaluation, none once funded.
